champion.tips: KALISTA TIPS AND TRICKS Don’t use your Rend E until you’re completely finished with the skirmish as you may miss out on extra Rend E stacks. Activate E as you finish the exchange. Make good use of your W by using it to scout vision in the river. Aim it as far as it will so it provides as much information as possible. You can use your Ultimate R to start a team fight by pulling in and throwing out your partner on an enemy who is caught out of position.
champion.builds: THE BEST KALISTA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kalista Top build, you should take Exhaust and Flash as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Sudden Impact and Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, followed by Berserker's Greaves and Guinsoo's Rageblade. For your last 3 items, you should build Terminus, Jak'Sho, The Protean and finish with Wit's End. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - Q - W. Right now, this build has 53.3% winrate over 424 matches played. Situational Kalista Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kalista build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kalista runes page.
